name: EMU Fall Classic
where: Dexter, MI · host Eastern Michigan · Hudson Mills Metropark
headline: EMU Fall Classic
summary: Final: Michigan State won the women's team race with 25 points to Michigan's 30, led by freshman Kaitlyn Reese, who won in 17:42.9 ahead of Michigan's Keaton Robar (17:49.7). Unattached Luke Venhuizen won the men's 5K in 14:45.4, with Michigan State's August Rohde (15:05.8) the top collegiate in second.
